method: Roll calls downloaded from official Indiana General Assembly roll-call PDFs (iga.in.gov/pdf-documents/...); members matched by IGA session rosters (getLegislators API) + surname/initial labels on each roll call. Org lists pulled from each org page on 2026-10-28 and matched to todo candidates by chamber+district+surname.

IFI_2026_scorecard.desc: Indiana Family Institute 2026 Legislative Scorecard (% support of IFI positions). Senate items: 1 HB1389 religious liberty adoption/foster, 2 HB1408 social media minors, 3 HB1035 unsupervised activity, 4 HB1038 casino relocation (IFI opposed), 5 SB76 immigration, 6 SB88 success sequence, 7 SB182 sex definition/birth certificates, 8 SB236 abortion-inducing drugs civil remedies, 9 SB250 hemp/THC. House items 1-6 same as Senate 1-6. Marks: ✓ = voted with IFI, X = against, E excused, NV not voting.

notCaptured: Americans for Prosperity-Indiana: no 2026 Indiana state-legislative endorsement list or state scorecard found (only the national scorecard at americansforprosperity.org/national-scorecard/ and scattered Facebook posts).
Indiana Family Action: no separate 2026 candidate scorecard found; used Indiana Family Institute 2026 Legislative Scorecard (IFI_2026_scorecard) instead.
